title: Build Pt-Nx-C structural models
action: Construct the four 8×8 graphene supercell models with a single Pt atom coordinated by 1, 2, 3, and 4 nitrogen atoms, respectively, and add a 20 Å vacuum layer. Output atomic coordinates in a format suitable for DFT input.
description: Generate input structures for Pt-N1-C, Pt-N2-C, Pt-N3-C, Pt-N4-C.

title: Run DFT total energy calculations
action: For each Pt-Nx-C model, perform spin-polarized DFT calculations (PBE functional, plane-wave cutoff 600 eV or equivalent, 3×3 k-point mesh) for the clean slab and for each ORR intermediate (*OOH, *O, *OH) adsorbed on the Pt site. Compute total energies, zero-point energies, and entropy corrections for all species.
description: Perform DFT total energy and vibrational analysis to obtain E_total, ZPE, TS for all intermediates.

title: Compute free energy diagram
action: Apply the water solvation correction as described in the literature and compute the free energy G = E_total + ZPE - TS + ΔG_solv for each intermediate on each model. Reference the clean slab + O2(g) to zero free energy. Output a CSV file with columns: model, intermediate, free_energy.
description: Free energy diagram values for all Pt-Nx-C models and ORR intermediates.
output_schema: model (string): Pt-N1-C, Pt-N2-C, Pt-N3-C, Pt-N4-C; intermediate (string): clean, OOH, O, OH; free_energy (float): free energy in eV relative to clean slab + O2(g), set to 0.0 for clean.
